title: SCS-C03: how an AWS request is allowed or denied

layers.name: Explicit deny
items: A deny in any policy ends the decision

layers.name: Organization ceilings
items: SCP caps principals in member accounts
RCP caps what anyone can do to your resources

layers.name: Principal ceilings
items: Permissions boundary caps one user or role

layers.name: Grants
items: Identity policy: what the user or role may do
Resource policy: who may use this resource

before: Part 2: who is watching, and what each one sees
caption: Read from the top: a request must pass every ceiling that applies before any allow counts.
